cohort: 69 prenatal patients with twin pregnancies undergoing cervical length screening at 18 and 23 weeks gestation.
finding: A statistically significant link was found between short cervical length (less than 25 mm) at 18 and 23 weeks gestation and an increased incidence of preterm delivery in twin pregnancies (P < 0.001).
gest_age: 18 and 23 weeks gestation (at time of cervical length screening)
